findings.title: Preserve recorded logs when deriving a contextual test logger
findings.body: FromContext returns a fresh TestLogger with independent recording state. LoggerMiddleware now emits completion logs through logger.FromContext(ctx).Info(...), so injecting a TestLogger records every completion on a temporary object that is immediately discarded, leaving the injected logger's InfoLogs empty. Previously these logs were recorded on the injected instance. Return the existing fake or share its recording state with the contextual child so logging assertions remain meaningful.
